news.title: Setton receives 2026 PSRS Lifetime Research Achievement Award

news.title: New, plant-inspired natural coatings can beat forever chemicals
news.summary_en: Researchers at Washington University in St. Louis have developed a PFAS alternative that serves as an effective water-proof coating, without the toxic downstream effects on human health and the environment.
